name: nightly-grid-compute
description: Identical-state nightly A04 EnergyPlus grid-search compute benchmark on a single cold school day. Measures wall/CPU/memory vs candidate budgets (10/25/50/100/exhaustive), parallelism, anytime regret, and RL compute comparator. No RL training. No BACnet. Use when running or publishing docs/results/nightly_grid_compute. Distinct from the Dec 17-day fixed-policy grid-search-comparator pack.
